text: Product Categories: We offer a curated catalog of standard products, stationery essentials, and accessories.
Pricing: Standard retail prices are cataloged per item. Custom and bulk sourcing orders are priced individually on a quote basis.
Shipping & Delivery: Standard domestic courier delivery takes 3 to 5 business days.
Returns & Exchanges: Unused items in original packaging can be exchanged within 7 days of delivery.
Contact & Support: For customer inquiries or custom bulk requests, contact our support desk or submit a message through the chat assistant.
